name: ai-bead-pattern
description: 本地拼豆图纸工具：上传图片或使用在线生图服务生成可导出的色号图纸。

scripts.setup: npm install && playwright install chromium firefox webkit
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && playwright test tests/e2e/seed-bead.spec.js
scripts.test:e2e:ci: npm run build && playwright test tests/e2e/seed-bead.spec.js --project=desktop-chromium --project=mobile-chromium
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.qa:ci: npm run check && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e:ci
